shortDescription: Manage NFS zone settings on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_zone
options.description: Specifies the access zone in which the NFS zone settings apply.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: nfsv4_allow_numeric_ids
options.description: If C(true), send owner and groups as UIDs and GIDs when look up fails or I(nfsv4_no_names) is set C(rue).

options.name: nfsv4_domain
options.description: Specifies the domain through which users and groups are associated.

options.name: nfsv4_no_domain
options.description: If C(true), sends owners and groups without a domain name.

options.name: nfsv4_no_domain_uids
options.description: If C(true), sends UIDs and GIDs without a domain name.

options.name: nfsv4_no_names
options.description: If C(true), sends owners and groups as UIDs and GIDs.

options.name: nfsv4_replace_domain
options.description: If C(true), replaces the owner or group domain with an NFS domain name.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
